text:
Elena: Hey team — planning a 90m Tooling Deep Dive for customers who are onboarding to Dedicated next month. Want to lock agenda, presenters, and a short registration flow today.
Jared: +1. Who's the target audience? Admins, infra, or app devs?
Elena: Primary: infra/platform + SREs; secondary: app dev leads who will integrate the SDK. Need hands-on demo of autoscaling config and network setup.
Priya: I can take the autoscaling section. Can we include a short troubleshooting playbook? customers always ask about capacity spikes.
Liam: I can do the networking/KMS bit. Prefer a 2pm PT slot so APAC can attend late evening if needed.
Sam (CS): We should cap live lab seats to 25 and run a waitlist. Also propose recording and drop the recording + artifacts afterwards.
Jared: Vote: Tue May 14 14:00 PT or Thu May 16 09:00 PT? I prefer Tue.
Elena: Leaning Tue as well. Agenda draft:
- 10m intros + success stories
- 25m autoscaling & best practices (Priya)
- 20m networking + KMS (Liam)
- 25m live lab: claim a slot (hands-on) + Q&A
- 10m next steps / resources
Please add or cut items.
Priya: Can we add a short 5m checklist at the end: pre-flight items for Dedicated (VPC peering, subnets, IAM roles)?
Elena: Good call, added. Also need a one-pager preread and a short registration form. Sam, can CS own the form + invites?
Sam (CS): Yep. I'll set up a Google form with fields: company, attendee name, role, expected technical level, prefer hands-on (y/n). Will drop link here in an hour. I'll also create a calendar event and a Zoom link.
enablement-bot: Reminder: please attach any slide decks or labs to the shared drive under /Enablement/Tooling-DeepDive/ before EOD Friday.
Liam: For the live lab, we need to surface a sample docker-compose + a quick config snippet. Suggest putting this in the preread repo under examples/dedicated-quickstart.
Jared: Can someone draft a single-line blurb for marketing/CS invite? e.g., "Tooling Deep Dive: autoscaling, secure networking, and a hands-on Dedicated lab" — short + punchy.
Priya: Draft: "Kick the tires on Dedicated: autoscaling patterns, network & key management, plus a hands-on lab to validate your migration plan." Thoughts?
Elena: Love it. Action items:
- Sam: form + calendar + Zoom (by EOD today)
- Priya: autoscaling slides + 3 troubleshooting examples (by Wed)
- Liam: networking slides + KMS demo snippet (by Wed)
- Jared: create invite copy + publish to CS invites list (tomorrow)
- All: upload slides & lab assets to shared drive (before Friday EOD)
Sam (CS): Form live: https://forms.gle/example123 — please don't publicly share. I'll post attendee list once first 10 signups land.
Jared: I'll send the invite copy to #marketing-ops for a quick pulse.
Elena: Thanks everyone. If you're volunteering to help run breakout lab rooms, react with :hand: and I'll assign. Aim to confirm final agenda and presenter names by tomorrow 10am PT.
Priya: :hand:
Liam: :hand:
Sam (CS): :hand:
Elena: Great — assigning Priya to autoscaling, Liam to networking/KMS, Sam to ops. Closing thread for updates — post major changes here so we keep the audit trail.
